text: {"name":"update_smoothed_ratio","confidence":"medium","docstring":"When the denominator at offset 0 is nonzero, initializes or updates the averaged ratio at offset 4 and resets the zero-denominator counter; otherwise, it saturating-increments that counter.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v1":"denominator","v3":"scaled_numerator","v4":"ratio","v5":"zero_denominator_count"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Denominator for the ratio calculation"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Numerator source, scaled by 2^16 before division"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Stored ratio average, initialized from the first ratio and thereafter smoothed with a 3:1 weighting"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Low byte counts consecutive zero-denominator samples, saturating at 255"},{"offset":9,"meaning":"Nonzero byte indicates that the ratio average has been initialized"}]}
